links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease of chatbot responses to MS exercise questions
links.effect: Mean FRE scores were 41.70 (ChatGPT) and 38.21 (Gemini); both classified as 'difficult' readability; no significant difference between models (p > 0.05).
links.quote: The mean FRE scores for ChatGPT and Gemini were 41.70 and 38.21, respectively, with responses from both models classified at a "difficult" readability level.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education responses
links.effect: Both models' responses were at a 'difficult' readability level (mean FRE 41.70 and 38.21), limiting patient accessibility.
links.quote: Nonetheless, patient accessibility could be limited by the poor readability metrics observed in both tools.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the quality, accuracy, and readability of two LLMs (ChatGPT and Gemini) answering patient questions on exercise for multiple sclerosis, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
